what_this_is: Grammar forms that are interchangeable in the same blank. build_exam_banks.py never offers a member of a class as a distractor when the key is another member of the same class and the class context matches: gf:n4:3535 「これはお茶（　）味だ。」 keyed のような offered みたいな, which is just as correct. Read by scripts/export/exam_rules.py (load_equivalents / interchangeable).
rule: Two options are interchangeable when both are in one class's `forms` and the class context holds. `before` (optional) is a regex that must match the END of the text before the blank; `after` (optional) is a regex that must match the START of the text after it. A class with no context applies everywhere. Classes list exact option strings; a form reaches the option pool only through grammar_point.forms_json, so a member that no level attests is inert until it is.

evidence_key.meaning: the owning points' en form_meanings are identical once the register tag (formal / colloquial / casual / polite) is stripped
evidence_key.label: the owning point's own label names the two spellings, e.g. '(後で / あとで)'
evidence_key.merge: a W08 / W08b merge ledger pair (research/derived/grammar_merge_ledger.json, research/derived/pending/w08b_merges.json)
evidence_key.registry: different points whose en form_meanings state the same function; quoted in `why`

evidence: meaning: gp-77 のような / gp-76 みたいな / gp-153 のような = 'like / similar to (before a noun)'
merge: W08b D5 (gp-154 -> gp-77); found_not_in_scope: gp-153 is a subset of gp-77
registry: mitai-na 'that seems like / like a... (+ noun)'
classes.why: Noun + のような and noun + みたいな are the formal and colloquial spellings of one pattern: お茶のような味 = お茶みたいな味.

evidence: registry: gp-77 のように 'like / just as (before a verb/adjective, formal)', gp-76 みたいに 'like / the way of (before a verb/adjective, colloquial)', mitai-ni 'like / as (+ verb/adjective)'
merge: W08b D5 (gp-154 のように -> gp-77)
classes.why: The adverbial half of the same pair: 先生のように話す = 先生みたいに話す.

evidence: registry: mitai-da みたい 'it seems like / like (informal)', n3-mitai-da 'seems / gives the impression of', rashii 'it seems that / typical of', n3-rashii 'seems that / from what they say'
classes.why: All three attach to a bare noun, a na-stem or a plain clause: 病気みたい / 病気らしい.

evidence: registry: you-da 'it seems / it looks like (conjecture from evidence)' beside the three above
classes.why: After a plain verb or i-adjective ようだ joins them (来るようだ = 来るみたいだ = 来るらしい). After a bare noun it needs の, so it is a real wrong answer there and the class does not apply.

evidence: meaning: deshou / darou = 'probably, must be; right?' (polite / casual)
classes.why: Register pair of one conjecture.

evidence: registry: te-shimau-chau forms {てしまう, ちゃう}, ちゃう = 'contracted, casual version of てしまう'
merge: W08b D7 (gp-151 てしまう -> te-shimau-chau)

classes.why: Past of the same contraction. てしまう vs ちゃった differ in tense and are not in one class.

evidence: registry: te-shimau-chau formation (〜でしまう → 〜じゃう)
classes.why: Voiced allomorph pair.

evidence: label: n3-chatta (～ちゃった / ～じゃった)
classes.why: Voiced allomorph pair, past.

evidence: registry: nakereba-ikenai 'to have to do / obligation', nakereba-naranai 'to have to do / obligation (more formal/general)', naito-ikenai 'to have to / to need to do', nakute-wa-ikenai 'to have to / cannot fail to do', nakute-wa-naranai 'to have to / it's necessary (formal)', gp-145 'to have to do (informal)'
classes.why: Six registered spellings of one obligation. gf:n4:3845 「待た（　）。」 keyed なければいけない offered なければならない.

evidence: meaning: gp-52 なきゃ / なくちゃ = 'I have to / I need to (do)'
registry: nakucha 'I have to (casual contraction)', gp-117 ないと 'I have to / if not... (casual)', n3-nai-to 'if you don't... / you have to'
classes.why: The clipped forms mean 'have to' only at the end of a sentence; mid-sentence なきゃ / ないと are conditionals ('if not'), so the class is limited to a sentence-final blank.

evidence: registry: te-wa-ikenai 'cannot / it is forbidden', gp-139 てはいけません 'cannot, it is forbidden (polite)', cha-ikenai-ja-ikenai ちゃいけない 'cannot (do) (casual)'
classes.why: Register and contraction variants of one prohibition.

evidence: registry: cha-ikenai-ja-ikenai じゃいけない 'cannot (do) (casual, after a voiced sound)'
classes.why: Voiced allomorph of the class above.

evidence: registry: gp-17 {んです, のです} 'it's that... (speech, polite / formal/written)', ndesu んです
classes.why: gp-17 owns both, but ndesu owns んです alone, so the same-point rule does not see the pair.

evidence: registry: gp-17 / ndesu
classes.why: Plain form of the pair above.

evidence: meaning: gp-116 んだけど / んですが = 'it's that... (explanatory)'

evidence: registry: de-gozaimasu 'to be / it is (very courteous)', da-desu です 'to be (polite)'
merge: W08 gp -> da-desu
classes.why: After a noun both are right (サービスです = サービスでございます). After an i-adjective でございます is wrong, so the class stops there.

evidence: registry: kedo 'but / however / although (colloquial)', keredo-mo 'but / however / nevertheless (more formal)', gp-25 けど
classes.why: Register variants after a clause.

evidence: meaning: gp-61 だが / ですが = 'but / however'
label: n3-dakedo (だけど / けど)
registry: gp-25 だけど 'but / only that (after a noun or na-adjective)'
classes.why: All attach after a noun, a na-stem or ん: 知ってたらよかったんだけど = ...んだが.

evidence: registry: demo 'but, however', shikashi 'however / nevertheless', n3-dakedo 'but / it's just that / even so', keredo-mo, gp-61
classes.why: At the start of a sentence they are all the conjunction 'but'. Mid-sentence でも is 'even' and けど follows a clause, so the class is limited to sentence-initial blanks (gf:n5:4278 ...んだ（　） keyed けど with でも offered stays a valid item).

classes.before: (?:ます|ました|です|でした|ません|ませんでした|ない|なかった|たい|かった)
evidence: registry: kara 'because / from (cause or starting point)', node 'because / since (reason)'
classes.why: Interchangeable only as REASON after a predicate. から is also 'from' (それから, 東京から) and ので needs な after a noun, so the class is limited to predicate endings it can recognise without a parser.

evidence: registry: gp-70 ごとに 'each / per / for each', oki-ni おきに 'every ~ / every X'
classes.why: 15分ごとに = 15分おきに. With days or rows they differ (一日おき = every other day), so the class is limited to minutes, seconds and hours.

evidence: registry: gp-38 どれ 'which? (pronoun)', gp-40 どの 'which / what ...? (before a noun)'
label: n3-kurai (くらい / ぐらい)
classes.why: どれくらい = どのくらい. Before any other word only one of them fits.

evidence: label: n3-kurai (くらい / ぐらい)
label: gp-44 くらい / ぐらい
classes.why: Free variants.

classes.why: Register pair, sentence-final only (…たらどう（　）ですか would print ですか twice).

evidence: registry: gp-30 なぜ 'why (neutral to formal)', doushite 'why?', gp-31 なんで 'why (colloquial)'

evidence: registry: gp-82 といいです 'I hope that / let's hope that (polite)', n3-to-ii-naa といいなあ 'I hope that / I wish that'
